photocatalysis is a promising technology to disinfect water from harmful pathogens.
photocatalytic TiO2‐mediated disinfection of microbes is a promising technology for the disinfection of microbes.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the disinfection of microbes (bacteria, fungi, algae and viruses) in water using TiO2 photocatlysts.
the development and evaluation of TiO2 based disinfectant for the inactivation of microbes.
the development of TiO2 based materials for the disinfection and deactivation of harmful microbial pathogens in aqueous media.

TiO2‐mediated photocatalytic disinfectant is a promising technology for the disinfection of microbes, especially in the presence of sunlight.

titania‐based decontaminations can be applied for microbial disinfection in aqueous media and it is a promising technology for water purification.
